text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to shake her fear of the pack, 
Tamamo Cross takes on the Tokyo Yushun 
(Japanese Derby) battered and bruised.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, proud to be counted among the 
generation's strongest 18 runners, she 
headed to the race determined not to show 
an unsightly side to her family.
